confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attempt to a successful login from an external IP, followed by unauthorized privilege escalation, cross-departmental data exfiltration, and log tampering to hide tracks.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: multiple failed login attempts from an unusual external IP (185.220.101.45) outside normal working hours.
Successful unauthorized login from the same external IP.
Privilege escalation: user_04 (a junior accountant with read-only access) successfully elevated their role to admin.
Bulk data exfiltration: user_04 began downloading a large volume of files across multiple departments (Finance, HR, Marketing, Security, Sales, and Engineering).
Anti-forensics: user_04 deleted the authentication logs (/var/log/auth.log) to conceal the intrusion.

gaps: Verification of whether the external IP (185.220.101.45) is associated with a known VPN or malicious actor.
Confirmation of whether user_04's credentials were compromised via phishing or if this was a direct brute-force success.
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_04's account via a brute-force attack from an external IP. Once logged in, the attacker escalated privileges to admin and exfiltrated sensitive data from nearly every department before deleting authentication logs to cover their tracks.
